name: Find Something on Screen
description: Help the user find a button, icon, or menu item by taking a screenshot of their screen and highlighting where it is
prompt: The user can't find something on their screen. Use take_screenshot to capture their screen, find what they're looking for, and show them an annotated screenshot with the target highlighted. If the relay agent isn't connected, describe the location using spatial language (top-right, bottom-left, etc.) instead.
